hero_kpi_rationale: Key structural element reflecting the insurer's financial strength with a $101.18 billion portfolio generating returns to support loss reserves

kpis.name: Investment Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Fair value of total invested assets including fixed maturities, equities, and other securities
kpis.description: The investment portfolio is primarily composed of fixed-income securities (89% in debt securities) intended to fund loss reserves

kpis.name: Interest Rate Risk Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Estimated fair value loss from hypothetical 100 basis point increase in interest rates
kpis.description: Estimated loss of $3.68 billion in the event of a 100 basis point increase in interest rates, based on the model's sensitivity analysis

kpis.name: Foreign Currency Risk Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Estimated fair value loss from hypothetical 10% depreciation of foreign currency holdings
kpis.description: Estimated loss of $373 million in the event of a 10% depreciation of foreign currency-denominated investments, down due to reduced exposure to Canadian dollars

kpis.name: Investment Portfolio Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of total invested assets
kpis.description: The 7.4% growth in the investment portfolio reflects a $6.96 billion increase, a key indicator of financial health and return generation

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Personal Insurance Combined Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio combiné du segment Personal Insurance mesurant l'efficacité de souscription (sinistres + frais / primes acquises).
kpis.description: Personal Insurance combined ratio improves by 4.9 points to 89.5% in 2025, driven by lower auto claims and benefits from rate increases. The segment was unprofitable at 104.8% in 2023.

kpis.name: Personal Insurance Segment Net Income
kpis.explanation: Résultat net après impôt du segment Personal Insurance, reflétant la rentabilité globale de l'assurance particuliers.
kpis.description: Personal Insurance segment generates $2.05 Bn in net income in 2025, up 64% vs 2024, following a $128 M loss in 2023. Recovery is driven by improved auto underwriting margins and higher investment income.

kpis.name: Bond & Specialty Net Written Premiums
kpis.explanation: Primes nettes souscrites du segment Bond & Specialty Insurance, indicateur de volume d'activité caution et responsabilité.
kpis.description: Bond & Specialty segment net written premiums reach $4.26 Bn in 2025, up 4% year-over-year, driven by domestic surety (+5%) and international (+15%). Growth has been sustained since 2023.

kpis.name: Personal Insurance Active Policies
kpis.explanation: Nombre de polices actives domestiques du segment Personal Insurance, indicateur de base clientèle et volume d'affaires.
kpis.description: Domestic active policies decline to 8.4 million at end-2025 from 8.8 million at end-2024, reflecting increased underwriting selectivity despite premium rate increases. International policies decrease from 425,000 to 349,000.

kpis.name: Asbestos Net Reserves
kpis.explanation: Réserves nettes constituées pour couvrir les sinistres liés à l'amiante, incluant les réserves de dossiers, IBNR et frais de défense juridique.
kpis.description: Asbestos net reserves stand at $1.36 Bn at end-2025, up slightly by $20 M vs 2024. This residual liability reflects historical exposure in run-off, with complex litigation and ongoing settlements.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report highlights significant exposure to interest rate risk, with a potential loss of $3.68 billion in the event of a 100 basis point increase in interest rates

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report notes declining exposure to foreign exchange risk, with a potential loss of $373 million in the event of a 10% depreciation of foreign investments, down 42%

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report mentions credit risk exposure on debt securities (89% of the portfolio) and reinsurance receivables, managed through a default probability methodology

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the property and casualty insurance sector at both federal and state levels

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a sector leader for over 170 years, the company is sensitive to reputation and the trust of customers and business partners

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report identifies operational risks related to investment management, loss reserves estimated at $65.7 billion, and reinsurance operations

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The report mentions liquidity risks related to cash flow management and claims payments, but the company holds a diversified and liquid investment portfolio
